scope: Structured language and availability findings supplement the full catalog. Absence of a route is not proof of exclusivity or inability to purchase. Original disc prices are dated market references, not stock checks.

3do.label: No system-wide region lock
3do.note: Imports can broaden the choice of discs. Some games need a Japanese Kanji ROM, specific NTSC/PAL timing or compatible hardware revisions. Region freedom does not translate Japanese games.

saturn.label: Import access with the right cartridge
saturn.note: Stock region protection can be bypassed with Pseudo Saturn Kai-compatible hardware. It also supports CD-R backups for patched copies. Region bypass does not change 50/60 Hz video timing. Per-game and cartridge compatibility still need checking; Tom has not tested this setup.

cdi.label: Region freedom: catalog claim
cdi.note: The existing catalog describes CD-i as region-free. Model, video standard, controller and Digital Video Cartridge requirements need a purchase-specific check; this view does not treat every disc as compatible.

segacd.label: Owned tower · exact region unknown
segacd.note: Genesis, Sega CD and 32X are owned. Console models, region and import access are not yet confirmed. No capture setup has been tested.

jaguarcd.label: Add-on needs a Jaguar base console
jaguarcd.note: The hardware guide covers the CD add-on only. A Jaguar base console is also required; the combined cost is incomplete until both are priced.

saturn-38.note: English fan translation listed for the Saturn release.
saturn-38.requirements: Buy an original Japanese copy, apply the patch to your disc image, and use compatible patched-disc or ODE hardware. A region bypass alone is not a translation. Compatibility is documented, not personally tested.

ps1-82.note: English fan translation exists for the PlayStation release; patch and playback setup need checking before purchase.
ps1-82.requirements: An original disc plus a patched copy and a compatible original-hardware playback method. Hardware setup cost has not been estimated.

saturn-56.note: English fan translation of the original Saturn game; this does not mean the later PC port is translated.
saturn-56.requirements: Purchase the Japanese Saturn game; a patched disc image and compatible playback hardware are required.

pcfx-1.note: Team Innocent patch 0.9.1 translates game text, but subtitled FMVs are separate videos rather than integrated into the game.
pcfx-1.requirements: The patch project documents burning the patched image for real PC-FX hardware. Story FMV subtitles must currently be watched separately; this is not counted as a complete English route.
